input.cmd:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$memory=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
$disk=Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID='C:'"
$heavy=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(vivado|verilator_bin|Vtb_s2b.*)\.exe$' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CreationDate,ExecutablePath)
[pscustomobject]@{at=[DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o');free_ram_bytes=[int64]$memory.FreePhysicalMemory*1024;c_disk_free_bytes=[int64]$disk.FreeSpace;heavy=$heavy} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
input.justification: 在综合启动前只读核验可用内存、磁盘及真实重型进程，遵守单任务资源限制。
